title: What If a Herd of Elephants Just Kept Walking? In 2020 One Walked 500 km

scenes.text: What if a herd of wild elephants left home and just kept walking? In 2020, one did.
In March 2020, about fifteen Asian elephants walked out of a nature reserve in southern China, heading north.
Over fifteen months they covered 500 kilometers, down paved roads, through villages, a calf born on the way.
By June 2021 they stood at the edge of Kunming, a city of seven million people.
More than 150,000 people were moved out of their path. Drones tracked them, and 180 tons of food steered them.
In August they were guided back south across a river bridge. The crop bill passed a million dollars. Nobody knows why they left.

description:
What if a herd of wild elephants left home and kept walking? In March 2020 a herd of about fifteen Asian elephants left a nature reserve in Xishuangbanna, in China's Yunnan province, and headed north.
They travelled roughly 500 km and by June 2021 had reached the edge of Kunming, a city of seven million. Officials evacuated more than 150,000 residents along the way, deployed over 25,000 police and staff with trucks and drones, and laid out 180 tonnes of food to steer the herd; crop damage passed a million dollars. On 8 August 2021 the elephants were guided back south across the Yuanjiang River. Why they left has never been settled.
